_comment: Example comments for the demo, keyed by '<type>:<name>'. Comments written in the app are stored in the browser's local storage only; there is no backend.

port:22.author: Nick
port:22.text: We should restrict SSH to the bastion hosts only. Most of these do not need it open to the world.

port:22.author: Ole
port:22.text: Agreed. I have a policy draft that limits it to the 10.0.0.0/8 range; will share it this week.

software:cfengine.author: Craig
software:cfengine.text: Upgrade to 3.27 is going well. The remaining 3.18 hosts are the old CentOS 7 boxes.

group:Linux.author: Nick
group:Linux.text: Reminder: the Linux group is defined by OS name matching in groups.json, so new distributions need to be added there.

class:any.author: Ole
class:any.text: Every host has this class, which makes it handy for checking that all hosts report in.

os:Ubuntu 24.author: Craig
os:Ubuntu 24.text: Ubuntu 24.04 is our default for new machines from now on.

user:root.author: Nick
user:root.text: Direct root login over SSH is disabled everywhere except the hubs. Let's fix the hubs too.

cloud:AWS.author: Ole
cloud:AWS.text: Most of the AWS fleet is in eu-north-1. The metadata service is reachable on 169.254.169.254 as usual.

host:SHA=53ebfe916b13796739cc7cf0b5028d6.author: Craig
host:SHA=53ebfe916b13796739cc7cf0b5028d6.text: staging8-dns-alice was rebuilt last week; the old hardware went to the lab.

path:/etc/ssh/sshd_config.author: Ole
path:/etc/ssh/sshd_config.text: Two checksums here: production and staging have PasswordAuthentication no, the rest still allow passwords. Let us turn it off everywhere once the last keys are distributed.

filename:promises.cf.author: Nick
filename:promises.cf.text: The hosts still on the 3.27.0 policy are the ones that have not reported in for a while; they will pick up 3.27.1 as soon as they are back online.
